data.description:
## Context

F32, F33, F34A, and F37 are approved. Current documentation cites deleted shell writers, understates the ensure registry, misstates its exception contract, retains obsolete ADR identifiers, and calls Jira Data Center a future backend.

## Plan

- Replace current concurrency citations with maintained Python symbols while preserving historical discussion.
- Document all nine ensure units and StoreIncompatibleError propagation.
- Separate the implemented compatibility record from the unimplemented ordered ledger.
- Correct obsolete ADR cross references.
- Correct only the two approved Jira-family module descriptions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Current concurrency citations resolve to maintained Python symbols.
- [ ] Migration guidance lists nine units and states that StoreIncompatibleError escapes the otherwise fail-soft sweep.
- [ ] Migration guidance distinguishes the implemented compatibility record from the unimplemented ordered ledger.
- [ ] Former Fast Forward Only references resolve to ADR 0090, and vote-carry references resolve to ADR 0091.
- [ ] ADR statuses, supersession banners, renumbering history, and decision substance remain unchanged.
- [ ] The two Jira-family descriptions identify Data Center as implemented.
- [ ] ADR checks, focused Jira-family tests, lint, type checking, and whitespace checks pass.
- [ ] No broader comment cleanup or behavior change occurs.
data.title: Correct concurrency, migration, ADR, and Jira-family documentation
